ideas.piece_safety: Look for a piece that nothing protects, yours or theirs.
ideas.opponent_threats: Ask what their last move attacks.
ideas.checks_captures_threats: List every check, capture and threat before choosing.
ideas.tactic_fork: One move attacks two things at once.
ideas.tactic_pin: A piece cannot move without exposing something more valuable.
ideas.tactic_skewer: Attack the valuable piece so it must move, and take what stands behind it.
ideas.tactic_discovered: Move one piece to unmask another.
ideas.tactic_backrank: Their king is boxed in by its own pawns.
ideas.tactic_removing_defender: Take, chase or distract the piece that guards the target.
ideas.default: Check what is attacked and what is protected.
